# orchestra_integration_connections (Data Source)

Integration connections configured in the workspace. Use this to resolve the connection IDs that pipeline tasks reference through `connection`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve the connection ID a pipeline task should reference.
data "orchestra_integration_connections" "snowflake" {
  integration = "SNOWFLAKE"
  auth_status = "SUCCEEDED"
}

output "default_snowflake_connection" {
  value = one([
    for c in data.orchestra_integration_connections.snowflake.connections :
    c.connection_id if c.is_default
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_status` (String) Only return connections in this authentication state.
- `integration` (String) Only return connections for this integration.

### Read-Only

- `connections` (Attributes List) Matching connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `auth_status` (String) Authentication state.
- `connection_id` (String) Connection ID, as referenced by a task's connection field.
- `connection_name` (String) Human-readable connection name.
- `created_at` (String) When the connection was created.
- `integration` (String) Integration the connection is for.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default connection for the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) When the connection was last updated.
